INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Poetry.

2. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

9. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose
